about: AI-1 test cases for the template's next version: minimum and maximum lookups (impl/formulas/spec.md, sections 1-12) on the requirement table of the full candidate. The 983 scenarios (id, group, inputs) are the formulas agent's (impl/formulas/testcases.json, which is computed on the base dump + the formulas fragment only); here every value, descriptor and flag is computed with nextbuild/eval/sheval_next.py 2026-10-20.1 (round_mode decimal15) on the base dump dump-18OCT26-20261019 + every op of the composed candidate ai1/candidate/changes.candidate.json (nextbuild, approved, values, plainfixes, energy, formulas and the notes folders), so the values fragment's data (ai1/spec-values.md: 5a, 5b, 5e, 5f, 8a, the choline maximum, 3c, 4a, 4c, 4d, 4g) and the energy fragment's row 4 (impl/energy/spec.md) are in. Inputs not listed are the candidate's: B3 15, E3 blank, G3 0, K3 0, M3 'None', B4 'Average laboratory or active (130 * kg BW^0.75)', D4 'Not selected or a cat', K4 blank, G10 and G130 blank, every entry in G and I blank (I3, which the random group still sets, is no input of the next version: the energy fragment clears H3:I3 and no formula reads them). Values: number, text, true/false, null (blank) or {"error": code}, aligned with 'cells'. 'descriptors' gives the L or N text and the AR sentence of each row with an entry. 'flags' lists the evaluator's assumption flags per cell (ai1/README.md says which a live check has since confirmed). 'old' gives the 18OCT26 value (base dump, same inputs) of every output cell whose value changed, the AR sentences aside; 'changed_from_18OCT26' lists those cells (AR sentences included). The AR sentences are the formulas folder's state: AR proposal on, batch 7 fix off. Compare numbers with a relative tolerance of 1e-12, texts exactly.
